blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Antonia Ruzic – Hong Kong Open quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala survived another grueling battle in the 2026 Hong Kong Tennis Open, beating Antonia Ruzic of Croatia, 7-6 (7), 7-5, on Friday to advance to the semifinals. Eala battled in another lengthy tiebreak for a second night in a row, then rallied in the second set to wrap up the match in two hours and 30 minutes. She was coming off a tough 6-4, 7-6 (7) win over Tereza Valentova that lasted nearly two hours. The Filipino world No. 17 faces tournament fourth seed Maria Sakkari in the […]...
